scripts.title: OP SCRIPT KEYLESS | Besto
scripts.features:
​🕹️ Movement Options

​WalkSpeed & JumpPower Sliders: Adjust your movement speed and jump height in real time.

​Noclip (Wallhack Movement): Bypass wall collisions using RunService.Stepped physics manipulation to walk through solid obstacles.

​Infinite Jump: Jump repeatedly in mid-air without falling back down.

​Click TP (Ctrl + Left Click): Instantly teleport to any location targeted by your mouse cursor.

​Anti-Ragdoll / Anti-Stun: Prevents your character from going into a ragdoll state or getting knocked down by hazards/attacks.

​👁️ Visuals & ESP Engine

​Monster / Entity ESP: Highlights all NPCs, bots, and monsters in red across the map (including hidden or immortal entities).

​Player-to-Monster Detection: Automatically identifies players who have transformed into monsters/killers (e.g., in Piggy, Infection, or Flee the Facility) based on tags and team metadata.

​Player ESP: Highlights non-monster players in blue with their display names.

​Exit / Door ESP: Highlights escape doors, exits, and key pathways in green.

​Item / Loot ESP: Highlights collectible items, keys, and tools in orange.

​Fullbright / Anti-Fog: Clears map darkness and fog by adjusting ambient lighting for full visibility.

​Show Tracers: Draws 2D tracer lines from the bottom center of your screen directly to target entities.

​⚔️ Combat Adjustments

​Smart Aimlock: Automatically snaps your camera toward the nearest monster or entity within a specified distance.

​Aimlock Distance Range: Customizable slider to limit or extend the target tracking distance.

​Expand Head Hitbox: Enlarges the head size and collision zone of entities to make aiming and landing hits significantly easier.

​⚙️ Utility & Quality of Life

​God Mode: Continuously restores your character's health to maximum.

​Auto-Interact: Automatically triggers ProximityPrompt interactions (doors, levers, items) when in range.

​Anti-AFK: Sends virtual inputs to prevent Roblox from disconnecting you due to inactivity.

​Zoom Bypass: Unlocks maximum camera distance limits, allowing unlimited zoom out.

​🛡️ System & Architecture

​Weak Tables (__mode = "v" / "k"): Prevents memory leaks by allowing garbage collection to clean up deleted objects.

​Throttle Jitter Scanning: Scans workspace descendants in batches to prevent frame drops or game freezes on heavy maps.

​Character Protection System: Maintains speed and jump settings automatically when your character respawns.

​Modern Tab UI: Built-in floating toggle button, sleek animated intro screen, and sound effects for UI actions.

+Button Esp

scripts.features:
Modifies all guns you have in your inventory (DO NOT EQUIP WHILE EXECUTING)
- ONE SHOT
- INSTANT RELOAD
- FAST FIRE
- SETS AUTO SETTING TO TRUE
scripts.script:
local plrs = game:GetService("Players")
local inv = plrs.LocalPlayer.Backpack

for _, gun in ipairs(inv:GetChildren()) do
	if gun:FindFirstChild("Setting") and gun.Setting:FindFirstChild("1") then
		local module = require(gun.Setting["1"])
        module.Auto = true
		module.BaseDamage = math.huge
		module.ReloadTime = 0
		module.FireRate = 0
		print("Vibrant's Backrooms Gun Mods: Successfully modded " .. gun.Name .. "!")
	end
end

scripts.title: hub
scripts.features: Godmode unlock all game pass max level
scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Red Panda Industries - Backrooms Hub",
   LoadingTitle = "Loading Script Hub...",
   LoadingSubtitle = "by Delta User",
   ConfigurationSaving = {
      Enabled = true,
      FolderName = "BackroomsHubConfig",
      FileName = "BigHub"
   },
   Discord = {
      Enabled = false,
      Invite = "noinvite",
      RememberJoins = true
   },
   KeySystem = false
})

local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Main Features", 4483362458) -- Title, Image ID

-- 1. GOD MODE FEATURE
local GodModeToggle = MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "God Mode (Local)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "GodModeFlag",
   Callback = function(Value)
      _G.GodMode = Value
      while _G.GodMode do
         task.wait(0.1)
         pcall(function()
            -- Set local player health to math.huge (infinity)
            -- Note: If the game has server-side kill blocks, this may only protect from local damage
            if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
               game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.MaxHealth = math.huge
               game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Health = math.huge
            end
         end)
      end
      -- Reset health back to normal when turned off
      pcall(function()
         if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.MaxHealth = 100
            game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Health = 100
         end
       pcall)
   end,
})

-- 2. MAX LEVEL FEATURE
local MaxLevelButton = MainTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Attempt Max Level (Client-Side Visual)",
   Callback = function()
      -- WARNING: This is usually visual only unless a RemoteEvent exploit is found.
      -- You must replace "leaderstats" and "Level" with the exact names used by the game.
      pcall(function()
         local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
         local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or player:FindFirstChild("Data")
         if stats then
            local levelVal = stats:FindFirstChild("Level") or stats:FindFirstChild("Rank")
            if levelVal then
               levelVal.Value = 99999 -- Changes it on your screen
            end
         end
      end)
      Rayfield:Notify({
         Name = "Level Applied",
         Content = "If the game saves data securely, this change is only visual.",
         Duration = 5,
         Image = 4483362458,
      })
   end,
})

-- 3. GET ALL GAMEPASSES FEATURE
local GamepassButton = MainTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Unlock Gamepass Tools/Skins (Local)",
   Callback = function()
      -- Standard gamepass bypasses involve spoofing the "UserOwnsGamePassAsync" check 
      -- or manually giving yourself the gamepass items found in ReplicatedStorage.
      Rayfield:Notify({
         Name = "Gamepass Unlocker",
         Content = "Scanning game files for hidden gamepass tools...",
         Duration = 4,
         Image = 4483362458,
      })
      
      pcall(function()
         -- Example method: Moving tools from a public folder to your backpack
         -- This only works if the developer left tools accessible in ReplicatedStorage
         for _, item in pairs(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") then
               local clone = item:Clone()
               clone.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack
            end
         end
      end)
   end,
})
